answer: Like a mycelium web enduring a fierce gale, decentralized consensus binds identity to collaborative history. Each autonomous transaction weaves a cryptographic thread into an immutable graph, where validation requires tracing verifiable co-reliance across the collective root network. When an entity attempts to distort the ledger, consensus algorithms weigh the marginal delta of genuine entropy added. Fabricating collateral relationships demands superlinear attacker cost as verification depth scales, choking hollow clone nodes into computational obsolescence.
